tei:div.tei:p: "$ (301)༄༅// rdzogs chen sems sde brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyi

dga' ston bzhugs so// (302)༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+ya/ ye shes rig pa gzhan du ma 'khrul bas// thog ma'i gzhi la mngon par byang chub pa// dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dag pa'i dbyings las thugs rje rol pa'i skur// mngon par snang ba bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// khyab bdag ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rang snang ma 'gags gzhan snang der ston pa// 'gro ba'i gnyen cig skal ldan yongs kyi mgon// mchog gi sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= /sbyangs pa mthar son paṇa chen lnga brgya'i gtso// las 'phro bzang pos theg pa'i rtse rgyal rnyed// slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la// gsol ba 'debs so= /shes bya kun mkhyen kun mkhyen gnyis par grags// rdzogs chen dgongs pa ris med mngon du gyur// paṇa chen grub pa'i dbang phyug shrī seng*// gsol ba= /yang dag bcu gcig don ldan lo tsā ba// lta dgongs mthar phyin snang srid zil gyis mnan// mkhas pa ba gor bai ro tsan la// gsol ba/ sbyangs pa'i (303)'phro sad chos kun thugs su chud// bai ros rjes bzung mchog gi dngos grub thob// grub chen rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po la// gsol ba= chu bo bzhi 'dus mnyam med lo tsā ba// skad cig gcig la sa bdun mngon du mdzad// slob dpon gnyags ston dzñā na ku mā rar// gsol ba= ring nas sbyangs pa'i skal ldan las 'phro can// bla mas rjes bzung mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs// skyes mchog sog po dpal gyi ye shes la// gsol ba= /mi lo brgya dang bcu bzhi rgya bod du// bskyed rdzogs sbyangs pa mthar phyin grub pa thob// bla chen gnubs pan sangs rgyas ye shes la// gsol ba= /mdo rgyud kun la thogs med mkhyen pa rgyas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dus gcig thob// khu lung gnubs ston yon tan rgya mtsho la// gsol ba=

/dwogs la shangs kyi gtsug lag khang chen por// bskyed rdzogs gsum ston snying po'i bstan pa spel// myang ston chen po shes rab mchog ldan la// gsol ba= /bla ma'i thugs zin ting 'dzin las su rung*// bskyed rdzogs gsum la mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ (304)chos lung myang ston ye shes 'byung gnas la// gsol ba= /'ug pa lung gi dben rtsa dam pa ru// bshad sgrub chu bos snying po'i bstan pa btsugs// mkhas grub gtsang sgom bde gshegs zur po che// gsol ba= /zur gyi rigs 'khrungs thos bsam mtha' ru phyin// lta dgongs rtser son bstan pa nyi 'od brdal// lha rje chen po zur chung shes rab grags// gsol ba= /lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtshos thugs rgyud gtams// phrin las rnam bzhis gsang sngags bstan srog bzung*// skyo ston sngags 'chang shākya ye shes la// gsol ba= /gdugs thogs stong gis gang zhabs gus mchod cing*// rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las can// gsang bdag dngos byon lha rje sgro phug par/ shākya seng ge/ /gsol ba= /gsung rab kun la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur// dgongs pa mngon gyur tshe gcig byang chub brnyes// lce ston lha rje dkyil mkhar lha khang bar/ rgya nag /gsol ba= /ting 'dzin mngon gyur thog gis mi tshugs shing*// ri gzar rbab kyang gyen la bzlog par mdzad// mtshungs med grub chen dbus pa zhig po la// gsol ba= /bsam zhing 'gro ba'i don la byon pa'i mthus// phrin las rgya mtsho 'bad med lhun gyis grub// zhig po bdud rtse sems phyogs bstan pa'i bdag /gsol ba= /gsar rnying chos la mkhas shing grub pa'i mchog /g.yo ru stod du bstan pa'i srol bzang btod// a mes chen po rta ston jo yes la// gsol ba= /mdo dang sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs mtha' dag la// bshad pas phan btags sgrub pa'i sa sde btsugs// sngags 'chang chen po rta ston gzi brjid la// gsol ba=

/bgrang yas grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol son// sems sde bco brgyad bstan pa'i sgron me spar// 'khrul zhig skye med dam pa sangs rgyas la// gsol ba= gzhon nu nyid nas ting 'dzin dus (305)'da' zhing*// yi dam zhal gzigs bshad sgrub bstan pa spel// skyes mchog mnyam med sprul sku chen po la// gsol ba= /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su ma mchis pas// skad cig gcig la chos rnams thugs su chud// zur ston chen po byams pa seng ge la// gsol ba= /sbyangs pa mthar phyin ting 'dzin gding dang ldan// 'khor ba'i skyon spangs rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma// ma gcig zur mo mkhas btsun sangs rgyas la// gsol ba= /mkhas grub rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi rgyan// rim gnyis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid mthar bsgrengs// 'jam dbyangs sgrol chen bsam 'grub rdo rje la// gsol ba= /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dge ba'i bshes// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa phyogs bcur spel// sgrol chen chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen la// gsol ba= /rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi// ting 'dzin dgongs pas nyin mtshan dus 'da' ba// shangs mda'i rgyal sras rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal// gsol ba= /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes// brgya phrag ting 'dzin sgo la dbang 'byor ba// kun mkhyen grub mchog grags pa dpal 'byor la// gsol ba= /thos bsam sgro 'dogs chod pa'i blo gros can// rab gsal rig rtsal 'byongs pa'i nyams rtogs 'khrungs// mkhan chen 'dren mchog blo gros rab yangs la/ rta nag thub bstan mkhan po/ /gsol ba= /zab gsal ting 'dzin sgo mang 'byed pa'i mgon// mkhas btsun bzang pos gdul bya thar lam 'dren// bla chen rdo rje 'chang dngos chos kyi rje// gsol ba= /sngon nas sbyangs pas blo gros phun sum tshogs// skye med don gyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur// nges don bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur bsgreng*// gsol ba=

/mtha' yas shes bya'i gnas rnams ma lus (306)gzigs// gzhan phan byang chub sems mchog mngon du gyur// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan 'dzin 'jig rten mig /gsol ba= /dam pas rjes bzung snying po'i lam la zhugs// gsung rab rgya mtsho'i lung gi thos pas phyug /snying stobs grub pa'i dpa' bo rdo rje 'dzin// gsol ba= /ka dag rang rig dngos 'dzin 'ching ba grol// bde chen 'gyur med mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig rdo rje 'dzin// gsol ba= /'di yan sh+lo ka bzhi badz+rāk+ṣa ras so// sems sde'i brgyud 'debs kha skong ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug mtha' yas chos tshul dpal/ smra la zla med mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i phul// lo tsā chen po dharma shrī la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// paṇa grub lda brgya'i gtsug rgyan bi ma la// bsam bzhin bstan 'gro'i mgon du legs byon pa// rgyal ba'i sras po rin chen rnam rgyal la// gsol ba= /o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshad sgrub bstan// 'dzin mkhas rdo rje snying po'i don gzigs pa// thams cad mkhyen pa au ḍī yā na la// gsol ba= sras bcas rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phrin las kyis// yid srub phyogs las rnam rgyal rig pa 'dzin// mkhas shing grub brnyes karma bi dza yar// gsol ba= /shes bya kun gzigs zab mo'i gnas lugs rtogs// 'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs med smra ba'i dbang*// rgyal sras pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje la// gsol ba= /bcu phrag rig pa'i mdzod 'dzin mkhas pa che// 'od gsal snying po'i don gzigs grub pa'i dbang*// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos bstan 'dzin 'phel rgyas la// gsol ba= /bslab gsum rnam dag byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs// rim gnyis mthar phyin rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dpal// sems dpa' chen po pad+ma maṅga la// gsol ba= /rgyal ba sras bcas ye shes gcig bsdus pa// gzhan phan pha mtha' yas pa'i phrin las can/

(307)kun mkhyen bla ma rig pa'i rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes so/ /smin grol rgya mtsho'i klong du thos brtson grur 'grus// zhugs nas gdams ngag nor bu'i mdzod 'dzin pa// ngag gi dbang phyug chos dpal rgya mtsho la// gsol ba= /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su mngon byang lngas// legs pa bskyed pa bstan pa rgya mtsho'i srog /rin chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sder// gsol ba 'debs= /lung rtogs dam chos pad+ma'i dga' tshal du// bshad sgrub 'od zer phreng ba 'gyed mdzad pa'i// bstan 'dzin nyin mor byed pa'i mgon po la// gsol ba= /'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas sgom ri dam pa ru// o rgyan bla ma'i ring lugs 'dzin mdzad pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgongs klong yangs pa la// gsol ba= /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs 'od stong gzis// 'jig lta'i mun pa mtha' dag lhag med du// 'joms mdzad thar gling snang ba'i 'od zer la// gsol ba= /kun bzang chos sku'i zhal skyin rdo rje 'chang*// gzhan phan thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rin po che// snyigs ma'i dus su sangs rgyas gnyis pa la// gsol ba= /mi 'gyur gzhi dbyings nam mkha'i rdo rje las// tshe dbang grub pa'i rgyal sar mnga' bsgyur ba// thugs rje'i rtsal 'chang mchog gi sprul pa'i skur// gsol ba= /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa lhur blangs te// sna tshogs thabs kyis gzhan la phan mdzad pa// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas chos kyi rjer// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'di yan sh+lo ka brgyad btsun pa gzhan phan pas so// las 'bras bden pa'i don la yid ches nas// dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin med pa dang*// 'chi ba snying la zug pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// rang drin rang la che bar byin gyis rlobs// 'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i snying stobs dang*/ (308)dmigs med zung du 'jug pa'i nyams len gyis// myur tu byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs nas kyang*// 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par=

/ye shes ston pa'i drin chen bla ma la// sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i mos gus kyis// nyams rtogs phun tshogs rgyud la skye ba dang*// gegs dang gol sa chod par= /gang ltar snang yang thams cad rang gi sems// sems nyid gar yang ma grub stong pa nyid// ma bcos rnal mar 'jog pa'i nyams len gyis// 'khrul pa rang thog grol bar= /ngo sprod don la nges shes brtan po yis// yengs med rgyun du goms pa mthar phyin te// chu bo lta bur rgyun chad med pa yi// mnyam bzhag brtan pa thob par= /gang shar rang ngo shes pa'i zab gnad kyis// rdzogs chen rang snang ris med mngon gyur te// byas chos thams cad dbyings su nub pa dang*// rang byung ye shes 'char bar= /nam yang bsgom ma myong par rang bab gshis// 'di la kun tu 'bral bar mi byed cing*// bsgom med don la gnas pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// nyin mtshan kun tu 'da' bar= /rgya chen chos kyi phung po mtha' yas pa// brgyad khri bzhi stong dag tu bstan pa yang*// 'di don rtogs slad gsungs pa'i tshul rig ste// 'bral med rtse gcig skyong bar= /sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// las dang bag chags nyon mongs dri phyis te// rnam dag sku bzhi'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas// 'gro la 'dod dgu'i chos char 'bebs par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems phyogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba// rje btsun bla ma de dag la mi phyed pa dang*// dang ba dang 'dun pa ste// dad pa gsum dang ldan pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o/ ༈ spyir sems sde la/ paṇa chen bi ma las bsgyur pa'i phyi 'gyur bcu gsum dang sems sde nyer gcig de dag tu ma 'dus pa'i rgyud (309)dang rgya gzhung mtha' yas pa yod cing*/ snga 'gyur lnga la sogs pa bai ro nas brgyud pa la'ang*/ brgyud tshul snga phyi bar gsum byung*/

bod 'dir bstan pa snga dar dang*/ phyi dar/ phyi sked bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ sa skya'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i dus yan chod la shin tu dar/ mnga' ris mdo khams yan chad du so sor brgyud lugs mtha' yas yod mod kyang*/ yongs grags la rtsa brgyud/ dbus brgyud/ dbus gtsang 'dres ma dang gsum du bzhag pa las/ 'di ni dbus gtsang 'dres ma yin/ bdag gis thos pa'i gtsang brgyud la yang brgyud lugs bzhi lnga yod pa zur na gsal/ yang dbus gtsang 'dres pa'i brgyud lugs gcig la zur chung nas glan shākya bzang po/ mda' shākya 'phel/ rtogs ldan shākya seng ge /kyi ston shākya ye/ mnyam med dam pa shākya rgyal/ bla ma lha rje chen po/ zhig po bdud rtsi/ sangs rgyas smyon ston bla ma/ smyon ston shākya 'bum/ skye med dam pa sangs rgyas/ skyes mchog sprul sku chen po/ chos rgyal mnga' ri'i paṇa chen/ kun spangs ri khrod pa/ mkhan chen mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan chos dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen blo gros rab yangs/ rta nag thub bstan gyi mkhan po/ bla chen rdo rje 'chang dbang*/ des bdag la'o/// maṅga lam/// / (310)
